Q1.rationale: Base NDA section 3 bars disclosure to any third party without prior written approval and has no express exception for reports to regulators; the only carve-outs (section 4 auditors and providers, section 10 FOIPOP) do not create a reporting right.
Q1.label: Entailment

Q2.rationale: V2 changes only the governing law clause (segment 36); the section 3 bar on third-party disclosure with no regulator-reporting exception remains.
Q2.label: Entailment

Q3.rationale: V3 inserts a new security and uniqueness acknowledgement; the section 3 bar on third-party disclosure with no regulator-reporting exception remains.
Q3.label: Entailment

Q4.rationale: V4 replaces segment 19 with an exception for disclosures 'as required by law', which is a carve-out the term excludes, so the NDA is incompatible with the no-exception term.
Q4.label: Contradiction

Q5.rationale: V5 changes only the penalty clause (segment 29); the section 3 bar on third-party disclosure with no regulator-reporting exception remains.
Q5.label: Entailment
